d.d: The eighth numeral symbol of the English alphabet, called aitch and written in the Latin script.
Abbreviation of hour, particularly when used as a (non-SI) unit of time alongside International System of Units (SI) units.
Abbreviation of hit, the number of hits by a player.
Abbreviation of hard, in reference to a grade of pencil lead.
Abbreviation of high, in reference to a dialect's social status.
d.x: An H variety usually enjoys official approval and cultural prestige.

d.d: Synonym of AH: in the year of the Hegira, used to mark dates employing the Islamic calendar.
The first half of a calendar year (January to June).
The first half of a financial year.
The second half of a calendar year (July to December).
The second half of a financial year.
